The '''2012–13 {{Lang|es|Copa del Rey|italic=no}}''' was the 111th staging of the {{Lang|es|[[Copa del Rey]]|italic=no}} (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The competition began on 29 August 2012 and ended on 17 May 2013 with the final, held at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|Santiago Bernabéu]] in [[Madrid]], in which [[Atlético Madrid]] lifted the trophy for the tenth time in their history with a 2–1 victory over hosts [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] in extra time.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://deportes.elpais.com/deportes/2013/05/17/actualidad/1368786951_099364.html |title=La Décima era del Atlético |trans-title=The Tenth was for Atlético |publisher=[[El País]] |date=17 May 2013 |access-date=18 May 2013}}</ref> [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] were the defending champions but were eliminated by Real Madrid in the semi-finals. Going into the competition, the winners were assured of a place in the [[2013–14 UEFA Europa League#Group stage|group stage]] of the [[2013–14 UEFA Europa League]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/Regulations/competitions/Regulations/01/94/62/40/1946240_DOWNLOAD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130514121404/http://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/Regulations/competitions/Regulations/01/94/62/40/1946240_DOWNLOAD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=14 May 2013|title=Regulations of the UEFA Europa League 2013/14|date=March 2013|publisher=UEFA|location=Nyon|access-date=1 May 2013}}</ref> but both finalists had already qualified for the [[2013–14 UEFA Champions League]] a few weeks before.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://ligadecampeones.com/champions-league-201314-equipos-que-ya-estan-clasificados/ |title=Champions League 2013/14: Equipos que ya están clasificados |trans-title=Champions League 2013/14: Teams qualified |publisher=LigaDeCampeones.com |date=13 May 2013 |access-date=18 May 2013 |archive-date=9 June 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130609024024/http://ligadecampeones.com/champions-league-201314-equipos-que-ya-estan-clasificados/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.marca.com/2013/05/05/futbol/equipos/atletico/1367705653.html |title=El Atlético se clasifica para la Liga de Campeones tres años después |trans-title=Atlético qualify Champions League after three years |publisher=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |date=5 May 2013 |access-date=18 May 2013}}</ref>

;Notes
*<span id="Note 1"></span>Note 1: Match in second leg of Round of 32 between Athletic and Eibar and the involved knockout of Round of 16 were delayed one week later. After the reschedule by UEFA<ref name=UEFA-Kiryat-Athletic /> of [[2012–13 UEFA Europa League group stage#Ironi Kiryat Shmona v Athletic Bilbao|Europa League match 'Kiryat Shmona v Athletic']] to be played on 28 November, the RFEF changed date to 12 December,<ref name=Athletic-Eibar /> and the first leg of the involved fixture of Round of 16 was played one week later.
*<span id="Note 2"></span>Note 2: Originally was expected to celebrate the second leg of Round of 16 on 18–19 December, and next rounds from 9 to 30 January in mid-week until semi-finals,<ref name="circular22" /> but according to the note 1 which always it would be one knockout delayed from others and the close celebration of league matchday (celebrated on 20–22 December, prior to Christmas holidays) it was postponed with agreement between clubs and television broadcasters to postpone the second leg of Round of 16 to 8–10 January and move next rounds one week later until 30 January and the celebration of second leg of semi-finals around 27 February 2013.<ref name="Calendar changes">{{cite web |url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=64389&ShowPath=false&Download=true |title=Circular 30: Modificación de las fechas del calendario del Campeonato de España - ==First round==
The draw for First and Second round was held on 3 August 2012 at 13:00 [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] in [[La Ciudad del Fútbol]], [[RFEF]] headquarters, in [[Las Rozas de Madrid|Las Rozas]], [[Community of Madrid|Madrid]].<ref name="First and Second round draw">{{cite web |url=http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=124&CATEGORIA=2&ID=2120 |title=First and Second Round Draw |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=3 August 2012 |access-date=13 September 2012 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130213064153/http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=124&CATEGORIA=2&ID=2120 |archive-date=13 February 2013 |url-status=dead}}</ref> In this round gained entry 36 [[Segunda División B]] and [[Tercera División]] teams. The matches were played on 29–30 August 2012.

[[Real Balompédica Linense|Balompédica Linense]], [[Real Jaén]], [[UD Melilla|Melilla]], [[Huracán CF|Huracán Valencia]], [[Lucena CF|Lucena]], [[CD Tenerife|Tenerife]] and [[Lleida Esportiu]] received a bye.

==Third round==
The draw was held on 14 September 2012 at 13:00 [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] in [[La Ciudad del Fútbol]].<ref name="sorteo-18oct">{{cite web |url=http://realjaen.ideal.es/noticias/2012-08-05/real-jaen-sonrie-sorteo-20120805.html |title=Al Real Jaén le sonríe el sorteo de la Copa del Rey |language=es |publisher=ideal.es |date=5 August 2012 |access-date=13 September 2012 |archive-date=11 August 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120811191251/http://realjaen.ideal.es/noticias/2012-08-05/real-jaen-sonrie-sorteo-20120805.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> The matches were played on 17–18 October 2012.

[[CD Alcoyano|Alcoyano]] received a bye.

==Final phase==
The draw for the Round of 32, Round of 16, Quarter-finals and Semi-finals<ref name="circular20">{{cite web |url=http://www.rfef.es/FCKeditor/UserFiles/File/circulares/CIRCULAR%2020.pdf |title=Circular 20 |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=15 October 2012 |access-date=16 October 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121021014841/http://www.rfef.es/FCKeditor/UserFiles/File/circulares/CIRCULAR%2020.pdf |archive-date=21 October 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref> was held on 18 October 2012 at 12:00 [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] in [[La Ciudad del Fútbol]] in [[Las Rozas de Madrid|Las Rozas]], [[Community of Madrid|Madrid]].<ref name="circular22">{{cite web|url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=61081&ShowPath=false&Download=true |title=Circular 22 |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=18 October 2012 |access-date=19 October 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121208054850/http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=61081&ShowPath=false&Download=true |archive-date=8 December 2012 }}</ref> In this round, all [[2012–13 La Liga|La Liga]] teams entered the competition.<ref name="circular16">{{cite web |url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=59868&ShowPath=false&Download=true |title=Circular 16 |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=28 September 2012 |access-date=28 September 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121023040314/http://rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=59868&ShowPath=false&Download=true |archive-date=23 October 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

Like previous years, Round of 32 pairings was as follows: the seven remaining teams participating in [[Segunda División B]] and [[Tercera División]] were drawn against the [[La Liga]] teams which qualified for European competitions, this is: four teams from Pot 1 (Segunda B) were drawn against four teams from pot 2a (champions) and the three remaining teams in pot 1 were drawn in the same way with the pot 2b teams (Europa League). The five teams in Pot 3 ([[Segunda División]]) were drawn against five teams of the thirteen remaining teams of La Liga (Pot 4). The remaining eight teams of La Liga faced each other. Matches involving teams with different league tiers played at home on the first leg the team in lower tier, in the other matches the first team to come out of the draw played at home.<ref name="circular5">{{cite web|url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=56727&ShowPath=false&Download=true |title=Circular 5, pages 30-38 |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=20 July 2012 |access-date=15 September 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121019070546/http://rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=56727&ShowPath=false&Download=true |archive-date=19 October 2012 }}</ref> This rule was also applied in Round of 16, but not for Quarter-finals and Semi-finals, which order of legs was pure as of the order of draw.<ref name="circular22" />

At the time of the draw, the result of the match between Las Palmas and Racing de Santander (which was played later that day) was not known.

==Round of 32==

==Round of 16==
The first leg matches were played on 11–13 December 2012,<ref name="circular22" /> except the Eibar–Málaga match, which was played on 18 December 2012. The second leg were played on 8–10 January 2013.<ref name="Calendar changes" /> The order of legs were changed in knockouts between teams from different levels, the lower league team playing at home in the first leg,<ref name="circular22" /> as was the case in the knockout [[FC Barcelona]] v [[Córdoba CF]].

==Final==
{{main|2013 Copa del Rey final}}

The Copa del Rey final was played at Santiago Bernabéu<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=124&CATEGORIA=2&ID=2466 |title=El estadio Santiago Bernabéu vivirá su trigésimo sexta final de Copa |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=8 March 2013 |access-date=8 March 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130301153947/http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=124 |archive-date=1 March 2013 }}</ref> on Friday 17 May 2013.
